'''Deckhands''' were members of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] crew who fulfilled a [[Technician/Legends|technical]] function. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] made use of deckhands aboard their vessels, with many of them being conscripted into the service.<ref name="FOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref>
